items.sentenceEn: The artist transformed the blank wall into a garden mural.
items.sentenceZh: 艺术家把空白墙面变成了一幅花园壁画。

items.altText: 艺术家在社区墙面上完成大型花园壁画，花鸟图案从原本空白的墙上展开。

items.sentenceEn: The final scene showed the travelers reaching the hidden valley.
items.sentenceZh: 最后一个场景呈现旅人抵达隐秘山谷。
items.scene: A theater stage presents one complete dramatic scene: travelers emerge through a rocky pass into a luminous hidden valley built from layered scenery, while curtains and backstage remain secondary. Performers have complete expressive faces. No script, signage, writing or text.

items.sentenceEn: The shelter checked its stock of blankets before winter.
items.sentenceZh: 避难所在冬季来临前检查了毛毯库存。

items.sentenceEn: Her career in nursing grew from village visits to leading a clinic.
items.sentenceZh: 她的护理生涯从乡村出诊发展到管理一家诊所。
items.scene: One continuous life-path composition follows the same nurse from a young adult carrying a medical bag on village visits through years of patient care to an older clinic leader mentoring others. Her recognizable complete face matures naturally. No timelines, uniforms with text, labels or writing.
items.altText: 同一位护士从年轻时乡村出诊，逐步成长为管理诊所并指导后辈的护理负责人。

items.sentenceEn: Despite the heavy rain, the crew repaired the lighthouse lens.
items.sentenceZh: 尽管大雨倾盆，团队仍修好了灯塔透镜。
items.scene: Heavy rain lashes an exposed lighthouse balcony, yet a protected crew continues carefully fitting the final glass panel into the lens and its warm beam begins to shine. Complete faces show determination. No signs, logos, labels, writing or text.
items.altText: 大雨猛烈拍打灯塔，维修团队仍坚持装好最后一块透镜，灯光重新亮起。

items.sentenceEn: A central fountain connected the four garden paths.
items.sentenceZh: 中央喷泉连接着四条花园小径。
items.scene: Viewed from above, one circular fountain sits exactly at the center of a symmetrical garden, with exactly four paths meeting around it from four directions. No people, compass letters, labels, writing or text.
items.altText: 俯视花园，一座圆形喷泉位于正中心，四条小径从四个方向汇聚到它周围。

items.sentenceEn: The octopus used all eight arms to open the shell.
items.sentenceZh: 章鱼用八条腕足打开贝壳。
items.scene: One octopus clearly shows exactly eight distinct arms arranged around a large shell, several gripping while others brace against rocks as it opens the shell. No extra octopus, people, numbers, labels, writing or text.
items.altText: 一只章鱼清楚展开正好八条腕足，协同抓住岩石和贝壳并将其打开。

items.sentenceEn: The rain garden absorbed the runoff, thus keeping the cellar dry.
items.sentenceZh: 雨水花园吸收了径流，因此地下室保持干燥。
items.scene: A house-and-garden cutaway shows stormwater flowing into a planted rain garden where soil and roots absorb it, while the adjacent cellar remains visibly dry with stored boxes untouched. The causal connection is continuous. No arrows, diagrams, labels, writing or text.
items.altText: 雨水汇入种满植物的下沉花园并被土壤吸收，因此旁边房屋的地下室保持干燥。

items.sentenceZh: 受损树根经过精心处理后，老栗树恢复了生机。

items.sentenceEn: A bright valley waited beyond the narrow mountain pass.
items.sentenceZh: 狭窄山口的另一边是一片明亮山谷。

items.altText: 透过阴暗狭窄的山口，可以看见位于另一边的宽阔明亮绿色山谷。

items.sentenceZh: 获救的狗很开心能和新家人一起奔跑。

items.altText: 一只获救的狗摇着尾巴在草地上自由奔跑，新家人在旁陪伴，彼此神情快乐。

items.sentenceEn: The final stone fit exactly into the empty space.
items.sentenceZh: 最后一块石头恰好嵌入空缺位置。
items.scene: A mason lowers one distinctive irregular stone into the only matching gap of a dry-stone arch, where every edge aligns exactly with neighboring stones. The complete face watches closely. No measurements, markings, arrows, labels, writing or text.
items.altText: 石匠把最后一块不规则石头放入拱门唯一空缺，所有边缘都恰好严密吻合。

items.sentenceEn: Dense mangrove roots protect young fish from strong waves.
items.sentenceZh: 茂密的红树根保护幼鱼免受强浪冲击。
items.scene: Strong waves break against an outer wall of dense mangrove roots while a school of young fish shelters calmly within the quiet protected water behind them. No people, shields, symbols, arrows, labels, writing or text.
items.altText: 强浪被密集红树根挡在外侧，幼鱼群在根系后方平静水域中获得保护。

items.sentenceEn: A quiet approach allowed the ranger to observe the cranes.
items.sentenceZh: 安静接近的方法让护林员能够观察鹤群。
items.scene: A wildlife ranger uses a careful low approach through tall reeds, moving slowly behind natural cover toward distant cranes that remain calm and unaware. The complete face is focused and respectful. No path arrows, binocular labels, writing or text.
items.altText: 护林员借芦苇遮挡，放低身体安静缓慢地接近远处未受惊扰的鹤群。

items.sentenceEn: The seals lie on warm rocks after leaving the cold water.
items.sentenceZh: 海豹离开冷水后躺在温暖岩石上。

items.altText: 几只海豹离开冰冷海水，身体平躺在被太阳晒暖的宽阔岩石上休息。

items.sentenceEn: The bowls increased in size from a teacup to a basin.
items.sentenceZh: 这些碗从茶杯大小逐渐增大到水盆大小。

items.altText: 同样花纹的陶碗排成一列，从左侧茶杯大小逐渐增大到右侧水盆大小。

items.sentenceEn: The farm dog carried a dropped glove back to its owner.

items.altText: 社区居民把小额资源汇入共同资金，并用它在风暴后重建新的温室。

items.sentenceEn: Rare lightning flowers occur when storms meet volcanic ash.
items.sentenceZh: 当风暴遇到火山灰时，会出现罕见的闪电花。
